lina: Bringing up sirocco-6b (gemma-ish arch) on qwen runtime. int8 runs look fine perf-wise but output coherence drops after paragraph breaks.
omar: That smells like tokenizer special-case or pos-id offset when bos/eos handling differs. Share a quick sample?
lina:```
# prompt: summarize paragraph
FP32: "Overall the experiment showed a 9% improvement and suggests follow-ups in section 4."
INT8: "Overall the experiment showed a 9% improvement
Then some unrelated mention of product roadmap appears."
```
rachel: newline turning into an explicit special token during conversion will shift subsequent token ids and corrupt kv alignment. Did we use upstream tokenizers.json or a fallback?
lina: fallback. upstream tokenizers.json has "newline_special": false and normalizer: "NFC". We used newline_special=true and NFKC. Also noticed combined emoji sequences tokenized differently.
omar: two fixes: 1) prefer upstream tokenizer config and run a token-delta check; 2) if bos is consumed by tokenizer, add +1 kv_pos_offset in the converted state. Quick patch: ```
if model_cfg.get('consumes_bos'):
    state['kv_pos_offset'] = state.get('kv_pos_offset',0) + 1
```
rachel: quant note: int8 can exacerbate a headwise rotary scaling mismatch. try applying "rotary_bias_scale":0.92 and per-channel weight quantization. we had a case where 0.86-0.94 fixed resonance.
lin a: re-ran with upstream tokenizer (NFC, newline_special=false), kv_pos_offset=+1, rotary_bias_scale=0.92, per-channel int8 -> much better.
eval-bot: baseline(fp32): rouge-1 0.44 | rouge-l 0.39 | hallucination 0.07
int8(before): rouge-1 0.31 | rouge-l 0.27 | hallucination 0.35
int8(after): rouge-1 0.43 | rouge-l 0.38 | hallucination 0.09
omar: nice. Please add two onboarding checks: 1) token_fingerprint diff for first 128 tokens vs upstream (fail if >3%), 2) newline-paragraph smoke (20 prompts with embedded newlines, fail if >5% hallucination regression).
rachel: i'll PR a small delta-check script to compare tokenized outputs (handles diacritics + emoji clusters). lina: opening PR with tests + conversion notes, and filing issue #4210 tagging tokenizer, rotary, quant. thanks!
